scripts.ensure:local:deps: (test -d node_modules || npm install) && (test -d server/node_modules || (cd server && npm install)) && (test -d client/node_modules || (cd client && npm install))
scripts.dev: npm run ensure:local:deps && concurrently -n server,client -c green,magenta "set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd server && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev" "cd client && npx wait-on http://localhost:3000/api/health && npx vite --host"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.docker:deploy:down: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && DOCKER_CONTEXT=${DOCKER_CONTEXT:-swarm1} docker stack rm ${STACK_NAME:-progress-report}
scripts.docker:deploy:ps: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && DOCKER_CONTEXT=${DOCKER_CONTEXT:-swarm1} docker stack services ${STACK_NAME:-progress-report}
scripts.docker:deploy:logs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && DOCKER_CONTEXT=${DOCKER_CONTEXT:-swarm1} docker service logs -f ${STACK_NAME:-progress-report}_app
